name: clawalkietalkie
description: Tailscale for coding agents. Give your assistant an address and let it message your Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and Gemini CLI sessions on any machine: hand off work, ask for status, get results back.

CLAWALKIETALKIE_TOKEN.title: Personal token (optional, secret)
CLAWALKIETALKIE_TOKEN.description: Optional and secret. A personal token (cwp_...) from https://clawalkietalkie.com/board → Security, scope messaging, for runs that can't sign in in a browser. Used only by the clawalkietalkie-token server. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth.
